briefing_md:
**Fresh 100.0m build locked in — a 3-5-2 projecting 43.7 pts, with B.Fernandes the standout skipper.**

**✅ What's strong**
The engine room is loaded. B.Fernandes (5.02 xP, pens/FK/corners #1) is the captain and the nailed heartbeat of this side. Behind him, Virgil (3.97 xP) and Gabriel (4.56 xP, vice) give real clean-sheet plus attacking upside, both on soft runs. Enzo at 7.0 is a proper differential, while Thiago and João Pedro carry genuine threat up top (0.61 and 0.57 xGI/90). No flagged injuries — but note the rotation warnings on Saka (~56'), Wirtz (~60'), Mbeumo and João Pedro (~68'), plus Gabriel at ~66'.

**🔄 What I'd change**
It's a build, so no transfers to make — this is the pick. Priorities: keep faith with the B.Fernandes captaincy and the Arsenal/Liverpool defensive backbone. The bench is thin — Mheuka and Fredricson are cameo risks (~26-29'), so don't lean on them for cover. Leno at 4.5 is fine value between the sticks.

**Bottom line: Nail the B.Fernandes armband, ride the soft fixtures, and this 100.0m XI is ready to fire from GW1.**
